name: Riven Hourglass Rewind (Combat)
body:
You are able to reverse the flow of temporality to recover from debilitating effects for a short time.

Prerequisites: Riven Hourglass Style, Riven Hourglass Eternity, Autohypnosis 11 ranks.

Benefit: You can expend a readied counter as an immediate action to suppress one ongoing condition affecting you for one minute. This does not allow you to suppress the dead, dying, helpless or unconscious conditions. This is a supernatural ability.
